partnership_announcements.description: Forterra announced partnerships with Volvo Defense, BAE Systems, CHAOS Industries, and Raytheon to integrate its interoperable autonomy across the defense ecosystem.

press_references.value: Forterra, RTX’s Raytheon and Oshkosh Showcase DeepFires™ Autonomous Launcher Prototypes at AUSA 2025

partnership_announcements.description: Forterra, Raytheon and Oshkosh Defense formed a team to develop the DeepFires autonomous launcher, with Raytheon as prime integrator, Forterra providing AutoDrive autonomy, and Oshkosh supplying the FMTV A2 vehicle platform; prototypes are being showcased at AUSA 2025.

press_references.value: Forterra and Volvo Defense Demonstrate Integrated Autonomous Mission Systems in Vehicle Platforms

partnership_announcements.description: Forterra and Volvo Defense showcased an integrated solution at DSEI 2025 to embed Forterra’s AutoDrive and mission systems into Volvo transport vehicles, signaling a new collaboration to deliver modular autonomous capabilities for defense customers.

press_references.value: Forterra and Higher Ground Announce Mission Driven Partnership

partnership_announcements.description: Forterra and Higher Ground have announced a formal, mission-driven partnership to support veterans and first responders through technology, therapeutic recreation, and education. The partnership includes sponsorships, mentorship, tech exposure events, and co-branded initiatives.

press_references.value: Fonterra cuts down plastic waste with Circular Communities Australia

partnership_announcements.description: Fonterra has partnered with Circular Communities Australia to recycle large industrial plastic bags, reducing plastic waste and CO2 emissions. The initiative involves a big bag recovery program that turns plastic bags into recycled products, supporting Fonterra's sustainability goals.

research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Robotic Research is engaged in developing systems for autonomous and semi-autonomous vehicle operations, including trailer assessment and maneuvering, driver aid and autonomous tractor-trailer parking and loading dock alignment, region focusing radar, autonomous gladhands coupling, and convoy management. Their work also covers detection and ranging sensor stabilization, intersection coordination for autonomous vehicles, and enhanced inertial navigation. These areas collectively advance transportation safety, security, and effectiveness.

overview_description.description: Forterra delivers autonomous mission systems for defense. From self-driving land systems to coordinated swarms of robotic platforms, the company builds scalable, robust, mission-critical hardware and software designed to empower customers to deploy autonomy as a force multiplier - extending reach, survivability, and effectiveness across the battlespace and industrial domains.

about_short_description.short_description: Forterra delivers autonomous mission systems for defense.

product.name: AutoDrive
product.description: An autonomous driving system for complex operational environments, combining perception, localization, behavior generation, vehicle control, and command-and-control communications.

product.name: TerraLink
product.description: A modular autonomous vehicle management and command-and-control platform for planning, monitoring, coordinating, and remotely directing vehicle fleets.

product.name: Vektor
product.description: An edge-deployed, software-defined communications and data-brokering layer for autonomous and crewed operations in disrupted, degraded, intermittent, and low-bandwidth environments.

product.name: Edge Compute
product.description: Ruggedized tactical computing hardware for running autonomy, mission AI, sensor fusion, electromagnetic intelligence, and distributed processing at the operational edge.

product.name: goTenna
product.description: A family of off-grid mesh networking devices, relay infrastructure, and software for secure communications, location sharing, and data exchange among distributed teams and platforms.

product.name: Vertex
product.description: A tactical electromagnetic spectrum sensing system that detects, classifies, and contextualizes spectrum events in real time for electromagnetic spectrum operations.
